bio.text: Jesse Petrea represents Georgia House District 166, which includes portions of Bryan and Chatham counties, and was sworn in on January 12, 2015.

According to the legislature biography, Petrea co-owned two statewide health care organizations based in Savannah for 28 years, selling them in January 2019, and is president of the consulting firm Green Heron Consulting LLC.
Petrea is a Savannah native and a 1989 graduate of Armstrong State College with a B.S. in Biology.
